items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: But on this number, like we played this time, Harry would take a solo.

ctx.x: I think you remember these names so well.

Harry Fagmitude and I, at the 100th Vigilum, they gave a dance if they wanted to draw a big crowd. Well, they want Harry and I, they used to call two banjo players bumping at each other. You know what I mean? Well, they'd hire me on banjo and hire Howard on banjo. Well, at that end of the band, they put Howard over there. And at this end of the band, they put me over here. And Howard would take a solo over there. And on that whole number now, it wasn't like at the preservation hall, everybody would take a number.…
Geez, have you heard this record that's so popular now with the young people from Exodus? What is that, Dick, the guitar and the banjo duet type of thing?
